name: The Lamp Keeper
notes: DRAFT for C13-5 (bestiary-plan.md; lore from drafts/content/lore/guardians-and-relics.json, unchanged). White Guardian on floor 5. Same shape as content/enemies/floor-keeper.json, plus phases. Stats are TODO for the Researcher (the scaling guide puts a Guardian at about 90% of the tier max; hits-to-beat in the 40-80 boss band). Faith tie-ins stay out until Jay decides; see faithOverlayKey.

attacks.name: wick wake
attacks.note: Lamps around the room light one by one; each lit lamp drops a small red circle, never two at once.

phases.tell: It lifts its lamp; red circle.
Lamps flicker on, one at a time.
phases.counterplay: Step out of each small circle.
phases.senseiLine: One lamp at a time. Breathe.

phases.tell: A slow striped lane and double marks.

lines.intro: The old lamp flickers. Someone is still inside.
lines.freed: A spark... I had forgotten how warm it feels.
lines.senseiAfter: Watch, wait, then answer. You did just that.

description: The Lamp Keeper sways its lamp, lights the room one lamp at a time, then dims a slow striped lane.

bestiary.tip: Watch the lamp. When the stripes come, DASH.

lore.white: Once it kept the Tower's first lamp lit. The shadow made it forget, but it never stopped hoping. Free it, and its light comes home.
